info.title: CF Meet Privacy Relay internal API
info.description: Internal HTTP surface of services/privacy-relay: GET /health (public) and the service-authenticated /internal/v1 API used by the authenticated platform ingress (Calling) and by Calling's protected-call authorization. Every /internal/v1 path — including unknown ones — requires a valid service token; customer credentials are refused. Scope comes only from the signed delegated platform context; bodies refuse unknown members (tenantId, applicationId, environmentId, status, version, authorization results). Commands carry {idempotencyKey, request}.

Resume a session. Requires an internal service token (X-CF-Service-Authorization), the receiver-granted permission relay-session.write and a signed delegated platform context (the only scope).
Revoke a session. Requires an internal service token (X-CF-Service-Authorization), the receiver-granted permission relay-session.write and a signed delegated platform context (the only scope).

Decide (and record) whether source may communicate with every target, on channel, over route, under the relay session NOW: evaluates the current context AND the current session (their intersection) at server time. Every decision is recorded. Used by Calling before every protected call creation and transfer introduction; Calling fails closed without an answer. Requires an internal service token (X-CF-Service-Authorization), the receiver-granted permission communication.authorize and a signed delegated platform context (the only scope).
Calling only: issue a short-lived Contact Resolution Grant for one authorized public-network call leg. Reveals no contact value. Every attempt is audited.

Telephony only: exchange a valid, unexpired, unconsumed grant (same scope, contact, call, leg; unchanged authority; enabled and effectively VERIFIED contact) for the canonical E.164 value of that one execution. The response is never logged or persisted; every attempt is audited without the number.
Lend a temporary relay number to the session (deterministic, SKIP LOCKED selection; idempotent per session). 201 new, 200 the existing assignment (Idempotent-Replayed: true).

200.description: The existing assignment of this session.

get.description: The session's assignment in any status (RELAY_ASSIGNMENT_NOT_FOUND when it never had one).

post.description: Restrictive (never gated by a kill switch) and idempotent: routing authority ends now, the number enters cooldown.

Telephony only, no delegated context: canonicalize the called relay number, require exactly one ACTIVE assignment (more is an incident, never a choice), matching correlation metadata, an event not older than the assignment, and CALLBACK_RELAY authority of the bound session and context now. Every attempt is recorded (relay_inbound_resolutions) without any number.

Telephony only, no delegated context: the presented caller number goes straight into the Contact Vault in the scope of a recent RESOLVED inbound resolution; the answer is its ContactReference (201 new, 200 an existing contact of that scope) and whom it may reach now.

Part IV L — Telephony only, no delegated context: the caller of an inbound call to a Digital Communications Number goes straight into the Contact Vault in the scope proven by Numbering's signed INBOUND_VOICE grant (verified against Privacy Relay's dedicated routing-grant trust bundle, NUMBER_GRANT_TRUST_BUNDLE_FILE; kind INBOUND_VOICE, issuer Numbering, audience Calling). 201 new / 200 existing contact. An invalid grant is 409 RELAY_MAPPING_NOT_ACTIVE; no configured trust 503.

cfServiceAuth.name: X-CF-Service-Authorization
cfServiceAuth.description: Bearer <service token> (contract cfmeet.platform.internal-http). Permissions come only from Privacy Relay's trust bundle.

platform.common.v1.CorrelationId.description: Server-generated identifier that stays stable across every hop of one causal operation.

platform.common.v1.RequestId.description: Server-generated identifier of one request / one service hop.

privacy-relay.authorization.v1.Authoriza.description: A recorded decision evaluated against the CURRENT context AND session (their intersection) at server time. validUntil is present exactly when AUTHORIZED. No contact values, no provider ids. An AUTHORIZED public-network decision (PUBLIC_RELAY / CALLBACK_RELAY) about protected contacts carries contactFacts: their routing country and read-time verification — never a number.

Internal communication authorization request (Calling -> Privacy Relay, service-authenticated). Tenant / application / environment come only from the signed delegated context; there is no client-asserted result.

privacy-relay.common.v1.AuditEventType.description: Immutable Privacy Relay evidence event types.

privacy-relay.common.v1.AuthorizationPur.description: Safe intent metadata of an authorization request.

privacy-relay.common.v1.AuthorizationRea.description: Normalized platform reason of a decision (no consumer-specific reasons).

privacy-relay.common.v1.CommunicationCha.description: Communication channel. VOICE is executed; MESSAGING may be declared for the future and is never executed by sections 26-30 (no chat, SMS or provider messaging).

privacy-relay.common.v1.CommunicationCon.description: Lifecycle of a Communication Context. REVOKED and EXPIRED are terminal; COMPLETED never returns to ACTIVE or SUSPENDED.

privacy-relay.common.v1.CommunicationRou.description: Route an authorization asks for. Only APPLICATION is executable today.

privacy-relay.common.v1.ContactReference.description: Opaque, server-generated ContactReference (UUID) of a protected contact, scoped to one tenant / application / environment. It never encodes a number, country, provider or user; knowing it grants nothing.

privacy-relay.common.v1.ContextPolicy.description: The typed, bounded context policy (never an arbitrary document). Defaults are fail-safe.

terminateActiveCallsOnRevoke.description: On revoke, actively terminate protected calls (new authority is denied regardless).

terminateActiveCallsOnParticipantRemoval.description: On participant removal, terminate protected calls involving the removed participant; when false they may continue but no new protected call or transfer involving that participant is authorized.

terminateActiveCallsOnSuspend.description: On suspend, terminate protected calls (new authority is denied regardless).

graceAllowsNewCalls.description: Whether new calls may be authorized during the completion grace period.

privacy-relay.common.v1.DirectionPolicy.description: BIDIRECTIONAL: any two active participants, both directions. EXPLICIT: only directed edges authorize; A -> B never implies B -> A.

privacy-relay.common.v1.DirectionRequest.description: A directed edge between two subjects; channel restricts it to one channel (absent: every allowed channel).

privacy-relay.common.v1.Enforcement.description: Active-call enforcement of a mutation (event ids of the durable enforcement jobs it created).

privacy-relay.common.v1.EnforcementReaso.description: Why active protected calls are enforced against.

privacy-relay.common.v1.EnforcementState.description: Active-call enforcement state of a mutation: NOT_REQUIRED, PENDING (durably queued; Calling has not confirmed) or APPLIED (Calling confirmed). Never claimed before Calling confirms.

privacy-relay.common.v1.ErrorCode.description: Stable error codes of the Privacy Relay API. AUTHENTICATION_FAILED, INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE and RATE_LIMITED come from the authenticated platform ingress; INTERNAL_* only from internal routes (never relayed to customers).

privacy-relay.common.v1.ErrorEnvelope.description: Error response body: stable code, fixed safe message, server request id. Never database errors, foreign-resource existence, tokens or contact data.

privacy-relay.common.v1.ExternalContextR.description: Consumer-defined, opaque, bounded reference of the business relationship (CF Meet never parses it). It can never be contact data: no telephone number, e-mail address or tel / sip / mailto URI.

privacy-relay.common.v1.IdempotencyKey.description: Client-chosen key: 1-255 printable ASCII characters without spaces.

privacy-relay.common.v1.PrivacyRelaySess.description: Lifecycle of a Privacy Relay Session (same graph as contexts); a session never outlives its context's authority.

privacy-relay.common.v1.RelayAssignmentS.description: ACTIVE carries routing authority; COOLDOWN quarantines the number after authority ended; RELEASED / REVOKED / EXPIRED are terminal (never reactivated).

privacy-relay.common.v1.RelayNumberCapab.description: Provisioned capability of a temporary relay number (voice only; nothing implies SMS, MMS or messaging).

privacy-relay.common.v1.RelayStrategy.description: Relay strategy: policy, not proof that a route exists. Every strategy permits the application route; the public-network and callback strategies only become executable when relay-number and telephony infrastructure exists.

privacy-relay.common.v1.SnapshotScope.description: Whether a relay session follows its context (INHERITED) or was explicitly narrowed (NARROWED).

privacy-relay.common.v1.SubjectReference.description: Exactly one opaque subject reference: a CF Meet principal id or an opaque ContactReference id. A ContactReference is never a telephone number, e-mail address or SIP URI, and Privacy Relay never resolves it (Contact Vault is a later section).

privacy-relay.common.v1.Version.description: Monotonic version (starts at 1, +1 per accepted authority change).

e164.description: The canonical E.164 number. Present ONLY in the Telephony execution-resolution response; never logged, persisted outside the vault, evented or returned anywhere else.

callerIdentity.description: The caller identity the leg presents: the relay number lent to the grant's relay session (its active, outbound-capable relay identity binding), selected by Privacy Relay — never by a client. Absent when the session has none; Telephony then refuses to originate. Present ONLY in this Telephony response.

privacy-relay.contact-resolution.v1.Reso.description: A Contact Resolution Grant (at most 120 s, never past the decision validity; a re-request for the same leg revokes the previous one). It carries no contact value.

grantSecret.description: Random grant secret (base64url); only its SHA-256 is stored. Handed from Calling to Telephony for one execution.

privacy-relay.contact-resolution.v1.Reso.description: Calling (protected-contact.grant-for-execution): a grant for ONE call leg. The decision must be a current AUTHORIZED public-network relay decision of this session involving the contact, made for Calling, at the current context / session versions; the contact must be enabled and effectively VERIFIED.

grantSecret.description: Random grant secret (base64url); only its SHA-256 is stored. Handed from Calling to Telephony for one execution.

executionAttemptId.description: Idempotency identity of the execution attempt: only the same service with the same attempt may retry a consumed grant.

privacy-relay.context.v1.CommunicationCo.description: Safe representation of a Communication Context. Never a telephone number, provider id, carrier, Contact Vault material, service token or customer credential.

effectiveStatus.description: Status at read time: EXPIRED once the final validity has passed, even before the expiry worker materializes it.

privacy-relay.context.v1.ContextEvidence.description: Privacy-safe support evidence: lifecycle, versions, participant and direction history, sessions, recent decisions, audit events and enforcement status. No contact values.

privacy-relay.context.v1.CreateContextRe.description: Create a Communication Context (Idempotency-Key required). Scope comes only from the authenticated credential; status, version, authorization results, telephone numbers, providers and relay numbers are not inputs.

directions.description: Required (non-empty) with EXPLICIT; refused with BIDIRECTIONAL.

privacy-relay.context.v1.LifecycleComman.description: Body of an explicit lifecycle command (suspend, resume, complete, revoke). Idempotency-Key required.

privacy-relay.context.v1.UpdateContextRe.description: Typed, versioned configuration update (never a status patch or arbitrary merge patch). Absent members are unchanged; participants and directions replace the whole set (participant reassignment keeps the same context). At least one change is required.

privacy-relay.events.v1.EventData.description: Bounded safe evidence: snake_case keys never naming secrets or contact data; ids, versions, counts, statuses.

privacy-relay.relay-number.v1.AssignRela.description: Calling (relay-number.assign): lend a temporary relay number to a Privacy Relay Session. Idempotent per session: a replay with the same criteria answers the same assignment (200), different criteria are IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; a session holds at most one relay identity ever. Requires PRIVACY_RELAY_ENABLED and RELAY_NUMBER_POOL_ENABLED, an ACTIVE context and session, a public / callback relay strategy and only enabled, effectively VERIFIED protected contacts.

privacy-relay.relay-number.v1.RelayNumbe.description: A temporary relay-number assignment. It never carries the relay number, its provider binding or the inventory id.

assignmentGeneration.description: Generation of the relay number at assignment (monotonic per number; delayed events of an older generation are stale).

expiresAt.description: Never after the session's final authority (narrowed with it).

privacy-relay.relay-routing.v1.DcnCaller.description: The protected DCN caller: its ContactReference in the grant's scope (201 new, 200 existing).

inboundCaller.description: The protected caller of a DCN call.

privacy-relay.relay-routing.v1.InboundCa.description: The inbound caller as a ContactReference (no number).

allowedTargets.description: Whom this caller may reach now (empty for an unknown caller).

privacy-relay.relay-routing.v1.InboundRe.description: The CURRENT safe relay mapping: the owner scope, references, versions and the validity boundary only — never a relay number, destination number or provider identifier. Anything else (unknown, cooldown, released, revoked, expired, stale / mismatched event) is the generic RELAY_MAPPING_NOT_ACTIVE; ambiguity is RELAY_MAPPING_AMBIGUOUS (fail closed, incident).

privacy-relay.relay-routing.v1.InboundSo.description: A protected contact of the session that may call in, and whom it may reach (CALLBACK_RELAY, VOICE, evaluated now).

privacy-relay.relay-routing.v1.ProtectDc.description: Part IV L — Telephony only (protected-contact.protect-inbound), WITHOUT a delegated context: protect the caller of an inbound call to a Digital Communications Number in the scope proven by Numbering's signed INBOUND_VOICE grant (issuer Numbering, audience Calling, verified with Privacy Relay's dedicated routing-grant trust — never its service-auth trust). Telephony asserts no scope.

telephoneNumber.description: The caller's presented number, handed directly to the Contact Vault. Never stored outside the vault, never logged.

privacy-relay.relay-routing.v1.ProtectIn.description: Telephony only (protected-contact.protect-inbound), WITHOUT a delegated context.

inboundResolutionId.description: A RESOLVED inbound resolution of the same Telephony service, at most 120 s old, whose assignment is still ACTIVE.

telephoneNumber.description: The caller's presented number, handed directly to the Contact Vault (canonicalized, fingerprinted, deduplicated or encrypted in the mapping's scope). Never stored outside the vault, never logged.

privacy-relay.relay-routing.v1.ResolveIn.description: Telephony only (relay-number.resolve-inbound), WITHOUT a delegated context: the relay mapping is the scope.

calledRelayIdentity.description: The CALLED relay number: CF Meet's own platform-owned public relay identity (international form). Accepted ONLY here; never logged, evented or returned.

providerEventReference.description: Opaque provider event reference (never a number, address or URI).

providerObservedAt.description: When the provider observed the inbound event (at most 15 minutes old, at most 2 minutes ahead).

providerStartedAt.description: When the call originated, where the provider reports it trustworthily; an origin before the current assignment is refused.

assignmentGeneration.description: Assignment correlation where the provider path carries it (must match).

assignmentId.description: Assignment correlation where the provider path carries it (must match).

privacy-relay.session.v1.CreateSessionRe.description: Create a Privacy Relay Session of a context (Idempotency-Key required). Everything except relayStrategy is optional and can only NARROW the context (participants, channels, directions, validity, a strategy among the context's allowed strategies). A relay identity or telephone number is never an input.

privacy-relay.session.v1.PrivacyRelaySes.description: Safe representation of a Privacy Relay Session (NOT a call; one session may authorize many call attempts). relayIdentityBindingRef is opaque and server-owned (never a number, carrier or provider resource).

executableRoutes.description: Routes the strategy permits that CF Meet can execute today.
